ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65-70% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and medial regions, and 30-35% high-intensity (white) pixels located on the distal lobes and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black mass occupying the central fluke body and notch area; distal lobes exhibit high-intensity white patches with high-frequency black mottling and discrete circular black spots (approx. 3-5 visible) on the left distal white region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; notch depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (1-3 pixels) interspersed with jagged protrusions on the outer lobe corners caused by biological encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex upward sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, barnacle-encrusted trailing corners.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant high-density clusters of raised, circular, high-contrast white/tan pixel groups (acorn barnacles) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous fine, white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally and horizontally, primarily visible against the black pigmentation on the left medial lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal lobe tips creating a secondary, textured geometric boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct, isolated black circular spots located within the white pigmentation of the left distal lobe.
